# Build pack render fixtures

`pacey-row-94-angled-before.svg` and `pacey-row-94-angled-after.svg` are the cover-page orthographic angled views for the Pacey repro (94 × 0.5 mm plates at 2.5 mm pitch on a 514 × 394.5 × 85 mm base). **Before** is rendered with the pre-fix build pack (`claude/strata-app`); **after** uses the plate-layer and path-precision fix on this branch.

Open both in a browser or viewer to compare slat visibility along the row.
